# House of Varsh — Luxury Handcrafted Sarees & Indian Couture

> India's premier luxury couture brand specializing in handcrafted silk sarees, designer lehengas, organza drapes, and bespoke bridal wear crafted by master artisans with over 15 years of heritage craftsmanship.

## Brand Overview
- **Brand Name**: House of Varsh
- **Category**: Luxury Fashion & Haute Couture (Indian Ethnic Wear)
- **Specialties**: Pure Kanchipuram Silk Sarees, Banarasi Silk Sarees, Designer Bridal Lehengas, Organza Drapes, Handcrafted Anarkalis, Tissue Silk Couture
- **Founding Heritage**: Over 15 years of master artisan weaving tradition
- **Official Website**: https://houseofvarsh.com
- **Official Instagram**: https://instagram.com/house_of_varsh
